variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Use 'var' when the type is obvious from the right side.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: C# 8+ supports nullable reference types for better null safety.

operators.title: Operators

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Modern C# uses switch expressions with powerful pattern matching.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.code:
for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { }

foreach (var item in collection) { }
for_loop.notes: foreach is the standard way to iterate over IEnumerable collections.

functions.title: Functions
functions.code:
int Add(int a, int b) => a + b;

Func<int, int, int> multiply = (a, b) => a * b;
functions.notes: Expression-bodied members allow concise method definitions.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: C# 12 introduces concise collection expressions. Spans provide zero-allocation slices.

maps.title: Dictionaries (Maps)

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Exception filters ('when') allow catching specific conditions.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: C# uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: C# provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: C# uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: C# supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: C# distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: C# supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: C# evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.notes: C# represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: C# implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: C# models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: C# manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.code:
var t = (Id: 1, Name: "Alice");
var (id, name) = t;
tuples.notes: C# represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: C# provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: C# structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
